Mama knows best

Encre’s music is so emotive and evocative, but I can never pin down
who/what it reminds me of, even in her covers it sounds so
intrinsically her, it doesn’t sound like she’s trying to be anyone else,
which is so rare these days. Her music feels like it comes from some
world of forms where it is just a pure expression of whatever
emotion she is feeling at the time.

-Zack Blue, Musician
